summary: Design golden paths, service catalogues and self-service workflows. Build an evidence-led IDP roadmap in this practical five-day course.
lede: Internal developer platform training helps engineering leads, senior DevOps engineers, and engineering managers design usable developer self-service. Participants map developer journeys, define golden paths, structure service catalogues and provisioning controls, and use DORA metrics to assess delivery outcomes while developing a separate approach to measuring developer experience. They also clarify platform ownership and plan roadmaps to report progress to engineering leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for engineering professionals responsible for building, operating, governing, or funding developer platforms and their self-service workflows.
prerequisites: Prior experience in DevOps, software delivery, cloud infrastructure, or engineering leadership is recommended. No programming is required to complete the course; familiarity with CI/CD workflows and infrastructure provisioning is useful. Advanced topics such as platform orchestration and AI-assisted catalogue documentation are introduced at operational application level, not production engineering level.
